[Shot 1] Wide long‑shot of the snowy temple complex in the top‑left quadrant of <Subject 4>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 3> are positioned in the foreground, walking away from the camera toward the distant temple gate; crunching snow footstep sounds trigger synchronously as their feet press down on snow‑covered ground with each step. <Subject 1> wears her blue and gold embroidered outfit, while <Subject 3> wears her deep red hanfu. The camera slowly pushes in. After a brief beat of walking, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 师姐，我们就快要到了</d>.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, medium shot of the ornate temple gate in the top‑right quadrant of <Subject 4>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 3> are on the left side of the frame, walking toward the right; crunching snow footstep sounds continue synchronously with their forward strides. The camera pans slightly to follow their movement. <Subject 3> (S2) says, <d>[Chinese] 是啊，但愿群主起来了</d>.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, high‑angle close‑up of the temple roof eaves in the bottom‑right quadrant of <Subject 4>. A bronze bell and a red lantern are visible. A single pigeon takes flight from the roof. A male narrator (S4) says in an off‑screen voiceover, <d>[Chinese] 故事就从这里开始</d>.
